column1: # Venus Lighthouse Aerie: the collapse, Sheba's fall, Felix's sacrifice and the party's return.

column3: We fought as hard\nas we could.{end_wait}
But the Venus beacon\nis burning now.{end_wait}
Saturos and Menardi\nfell into the pit...{end_wait}
They won't light\nanother beacon.{end_wait}
But {actor_name:5} is gone.\nAnd {actor_name:7} is\nstill with him.{end_wait}
What is wrong with you?\n{actor_name:1}, what are you\nstaring at?{end_wait}
{actor_name:5}!{end_wait}
Did you{pause_20_skippable}{pause_20_skippable} finish them?{end_wait}
I know how strong\nthey were.{page_break}You beat them.\nI won't fight you now.{end_wait}
I can't stay here,\n{actor_name:1}.{page_break}I have to go.{end_wait}
Come, {actor_name:7}!{end_wait}
Wait, {actor_name:5}!{end_wait}
Why won't you\ntalk to us?{end_wait}
They fell. It's over!\nYou can stop now!{end_wait}
You still think{pause_20_skippable}\nthis ends with them?{end_wait}
If you intend to awaken\nthe remaining beacons,\nyou will still need...{end_wait}
The Elemental Stars?\nWe have them with us!{end_wait}
Saturos and Menardi\nare gone, {actor_name:5}.\nWhy go on?{end_wait}
Because I must.{pause_20_skippable}\nIf the beacons stay\ndark...{end_wait}
What happens then?{end_wait}
You wouldn't believe\nme now.{pause_20_skippable}\nYou'll see.{end_wait}
We promised Faran\nwe'd bring {actor_name:7}\nhome!{end_wait}
The lighthouse...!{end_wait}
{actor_name:1}!{pause_20_skippable} They are too\nfar away! We cannot reach\n{actor_name:5}!{end_wait}
There's light coming\nup from below!{end_wait}
No!{pause_20_skippable} {actor_name:7}! Hold on!{end_wait}
{actor_name:7}, take my hand!\nPlease!{end_wait}
I can't...{end_wait}
Reach for me!\nDon't look down!{end_wait}
Look down...{pause_20_skippable}{pause_20_skippable} The\nlighthouse foundations\nare breaking apart!{end_wait}
Why is this happening?\nIs the power trying to\nprotect Venus Lighthouse?{end_wait}
I'm{pause_20_skippable} slipping...{pause_20_skippable}{pause_20_skippable}\nI cannot{pause_20_skippable}{pause_20_skippable} hold on{pause_20_skippable}\nany longer.{end_wait}
No!{pause_20_skippable} Don't let go!\nYou'll fall!{end_wait}
{actor_name:5}...{pause_20_skippable}\n{pause_20_skippable}Thank you.{end_wait}
{text_effect:2}{actor_name:7}!!!{reset_text_style}{pause_20_skippable} No!\nI will not let you die!{end_wait}
!!!{end_wait}
{actor_name:7} fell when\nthe ground broke...{end_wait}
Did {actor_name:5} jump\nafter her?{end_wait}
From that height...\nHow could he survive?{end_wait}
{actor_name:5}...{pause_20_skippable}\nHe didn't even\nhesitate.{end_wait}
From this height,\nwe can't tell if\nthey survived.{end_wait}
He jumped to save\n{actor_name:7}.\nI hope he reached her.{end_wait}
{actor_name:1}, what now?\nWe can't stay here.{end_wait}
What can we do{pause_20_skippable}\nnow? What {text_effect:2}can{reset_text_style}\nwe do?{end_wait}
{actor_name:6} is still\nout there. And the\nothers, too.{end_wait}
{actor_name:6}...{pause_20_skippable}\nShe still doesn't\nknow any of this.{end_wait}
{actor_name:1}!{pause_20_skippable} Listen.\nWe still have to\nfind {actor_name:6}.{end_wait}
{actor_name:1}...{pause_20_skippable}\nThere you are.\nCan you stand?{end_wait}
We have to find\n{actor_name:6}. Will you\ncome with us?{end_now}
Thank you.\nWe can't give up now.{end_wait}
{actor_name:1}, we should\ntell {actor_name:6} about\n{actor_name:5} ourselves.{end_wait}
She'll need us.\nWe should be there\nwhen she hears.{end_wait}
We can't leave\n{actor_name:6} to wonder\nwhat happened to {actor_name:5}.{end_wait}
She deserves\nto hear about\n{actor_name:5} from us.{end_wait}
When we find {actor_name:6},\nwe should stay\nbeside her.{end_wait}
What's wrong, {actor_name:2}?{end_wait}
I was thinking...{pause_20_skippable}{pause_20_skippable}\nHow are we meant to\nclimb down from here?{end_wait}
You're right.{pause_20_skippable} Getting away\nfrom this place will be\ndifficult...{end_wait}
It's back to normal!{end_wait}
The path... it's back.\nHow is that possible?{end_wait}
I don't know.\nNot yet.{end_wait}
We can search\nfor {actor_name:6} now.\nLet's go.{end_wait}
All right{pause_20_skippable}, let's move,\n{actor_name:1}!{pause_20_skippable} We must find\n{actor_name:6}.{end_wait}
After a long and weary\nsearch, {actor_name:6} was\nnowhere to be found.{end_wait}
